scope: Fresh local Anvil only, ports19545/19546; generated in-memory quote key; no public transactions or user credentials

checks.name: Fresh compiler output matches the shipped artifact and recorded source hash
Permits bind caller, domain, expiry, rules, policy and exact fee relation
Mint identity and stat substitutions are rejected
Payment and pause rejection roll back permit consumption
Mint atomically derives its expected seed and opens the included first day
An accepted permit cannot mint twice
Pending transfer lock covers owner, approved operator and safe transfer
Unauthorized accounts cannot fail or finalize an accepted request
Malformed versions, lengths, days, levels and bounded state values cannot settle
Malformed/incomplete/terminal-marked alive history and zero commitment are rejected
Successful state/history/result hashes match and duplicate settlement is blocked
Transfer preserves identity/save, updates enumeration/revision and invalidates old permits even after transfer back
Delivery rejects more than three types and unsupported bits
Failure is retained without biological progress; fresh retry keeps intended day/seed
Deadline equality permits settlement but not expiry; strictly later expiry is permissionless and terminal
Full uint16 stock cannot receive another unit and three saved testnet days cap admission
Day-one retry adds no starter/delivery credit; terminal NFT is retained, cannot play, and remains transferable
All nine economic/service/metadata admin mutations reject an unrelated player
Admin multiplier/window bounds hold; metadata remains explicitly owner-mutable
Failed treasury recipient does not silently lose a withdrawal
Malicious ERC721 receiver cannot transfer during mint or reenter mint/request/failure even with relayer role
Local chain4663 constructor rejects testnet mode and missing mainnet feed
Mainnet pricing uses explicit feed and fails closed for zero/negative/stale/future/incomplete/bad-decimal/unavailable data
Mainnet mint price rejects underpayment and signed drift beyond one-percent tolerance

trustBoundary: Only authorized relayer may settle; detailed game effects, stock provenance and actual Jev inference remain trusted service responsibilities. No formal/external-audit claim.
